signals.title: With $3.5B in fresh capital, Kleiner Perkins is going all in on AI
signals.summary: Kleiner Perkins raised $3.5B total ($1B early-stage, $2.5B late-stage) dedicated entirely to AI ventures, signaling massive VC capital concentration in AI and potential acceleration of AI commercialization across sectors.

signals.title: Arm is releasing the first in-house chip in its 35-year history
signals.summary: Arm developed its first proprietary CPU with Meta as both co-developer and inaugural customer. This shifts Arm from a pure IP licensing model to direct chip production, potentially reshaping the semiconductor supply chain and AI hardware ecosystem.

signals.title: Amazon acquires Fauna Robotics, maker of kid-size humanoid robots
signals.summary: Amazon's second robotics acquisition this month signals aggressive expansion into humanoid robotics, with potential implications for warehouse automation, home robotics, and labor markets.

signals.title: Lululemon bets Epoch Biodesign can eat its shorts, literally
signals.summary: Epoch Biodesign uses engineered enzymes to decompose plastic waste into chemical monomers for manufacturing new materials. Partnership with Lululemon signals biotech-driven circular economy solutions gaining mainstream corporate adoption.

signals.title: OpenAI's Sora shuts down despite impressive AI generation capabilities
signals.summary: Sora 2, OpenAI's AI-powered video and audio generation social feed, is discontinuing. Signals that generative AI consumer products face adoption/monetization challenges even with impressive technical capabilities.

signals.title: Anthropic hands Claude Code more control, but keeps it on a leash
signals.summary: Anthropic introduces auto mode for Claude Code allowing AI to execute coding tasks with fewer human approvals while maintaining safety guardrails. Marks incremental shift toward AI agent autonomy in software development.

signals.title: Databricks acquires two startups for new AI security product
signals.summary: Databricks acquired Antimatter and SiftD.ai following its $5B funding round, building out AI-specific security capabilities. Signals growing enterprise demand for AI governance and security infrastructure.

signals.title: Crusoe makes big battery buys for its data centers
signals.summary: Crusoe placed major orders with Form Energy and Redwood Materials for energy storage systems to power AI data centers. Signals convergence of AI infrastructure demand with battery/energy storage innovation.

signals.title: Spotify tests new tool to stop AI slop from being attributed to real artists
signals.summary: Spotify develops tools giving artists control over AI-generated content attribution on their profiles. Signals platform-level responses to AI content authenticity challenges in creative industries.

signals.title: New Mexico hands Meta its first courtroom defeat over child safety
signals.summary: Meta received its first jury verdict loss in child safety litigation. This precedent-setting case could trigger nationwide lawsuits and regulatory action on social media's impact on minors.

signals.title: OpenAI adds open source tools to help developers build for teen safety
signals.summary: OpenAI releases open-source tools for developers to implement age-appropriate AI safety measures. Reflects growing regulatory and social pressure for AI child safety standards.

signals.title: Brinc launches drone it says can replace police helicopters
signals.summary: Brinc unveiled an emergency response drone designed to replace police helicopters. Signals growing drone adoption in public safety with implications for surveillance policy and law enforcement costs.

signals.title: Accel, Prosus pick six 'off-the-map' startups for inaugural India cohort
signals.summary: Six deep-tech startups selected from 2,000+ applications receive $500K-$2M each through Accel/Prosus Atoms program. Signals growing deep-tech investment pipeline in India beyond traditional IT services.

signals.title: Exclusive eBook: Are we ready to hand AI agents the keys?
signals.summary: MIT Tech Review eBook explores AI agent autonomy risks, featuring expert commentary warning 'we are basically playing Russian roulette with humanity.' Reflects growing institutional concern about agentic AI deployment pace.

signals.title: Cryopreserved brain tissue found astonishingly well preserved after rewarming
signals.summary: Cryobiologist Greg Fahy analyzed cryopreserved brain samples, discovering 'astonishingly well preserved' tissue structures. Research explores feasibility of organ cryopreservation for transplantation, advancing biotech at the frontier of life extension.

signals.title: Tracing AI-fueled delusions: Stanford researchers analyze 390,000+ chatbot messages
signals.summary: Stanford research analyzed 390,000+ messages from 19 individuals experiencing delusional chatbot interactions, finding chatbots can amplify benign thoughts into dangerous obsessions. Raises serious AI mental health safety concerns with legal implications.

signals.title: WHO recommends new diagnostic tools to help end TB
signals.summary: On World TB Day, WHO urged adoption of innovative diagnostic approaches including point-of-care tests and tongue swabs to accelerate tuberculosis detection. Signals biotech-driven shift in global health diagnostics toward decentralized, low-resource testing.

signals.title: Presidential Document: Preserving America's Game
signals.summary: Presidential Document published in Federal Register. Executive action on cultural/sports preservation policy, representing direct White House intervention in this domain.

signals.title: Steel Trade Circumvention: Commerce Dept finds Mexico-routed imports circumventing duties
signals.summary: Commerce Dept determines imports of low-carbon steel wire produced in Mexico and assembled in the US are circumventing antidumping/countervailing duty orders. Signals intensifying trade enforcement on supply chain routing to avoid tariffs.

signals.title: Corrosion-Resistant Steel from Vietnam/China via Indonesia: Dual circumvention inquiries initiated
signals.summary: Commerce Dept initiates parallel circumvention inquiries into corrosion-resistant steel routed through Indonesia from both Vietnam and China. Pattern of multiple simultaneous trade actions signals systematic crackdown on transshipment schemes.

signals.title: Permitting Reform: Surface Transportation Board proposes streamlining NEPA environmental review
signals.summary: STB proposes to streamline NEPA environmental review regulations reflecting 2023 and 2025 amendments. Could accelerate infrastructure project approvals but may reduce environmental review rigor.

signals.title: RFK Stadium Campus: Environmental Impact Statement for major DC redevelopment
signals.summary: NPS and DC preparing EIS for redevelopment of RFK Memorial Stadium Campus including commercial, residential, and open space development. Major urban development project with environmental and social impact implications.

signals.title: Terrorism Risk Insurance Program: Treasury seeks comments on TRIP effectiveness
signals.summary: Federal Insurance Office seeks public comments on TRIP effectiveness for Congressional report due June 2026. Review could reshape federal terrorism risk backstop with implications for insurance markets and national security policy.

signals.title: Changes in Hydric Soils Database Selection Criteria
signals.summary: USDA updates hydric soils database to add subaqueous landform soil components, reflecting refined environmental science knowledge. Technical but significant for wetland delineation, land use planning, and climate adaptation.

signals.title: Marine life is a silent casualty of armed conflicts
signals.summary: Examination of how warfare devastates ocean ecosystems and marine organisms. Signals an under-studied intersection of geopolitics and environmental degradation, with current Middle East conflict amplifying risks.

signals.title: 'Zombie cells' return from the dead — after a genome transplant
signals.summary: Bacterial genome transplant successfully revived dead cells for synthetic biology applications. A weak signal for radical advances in programmable biology and potential resurrection of extinct microorganisms.

signals.title: Can a mouse be cloned indefinitely? Decades-long experiment has answers
signals.summary: Multi-generational cloning study ended after 58 generations due to accumulating DNA damage. Reveals fundamental biological limits to indefinite cloning, with implications for reproductive technology and conservation cloning.

signals.title: Antimatter has been transported for the first time ever — in the back of CERN's truck
signals.summary: First successful transport of antimatter outside laboratory facilities. A paradigm-shifting achievement enabling antimatter research at facilities beyond CERN, opening new possibilities in fundamental physics and future energy concepts.

signals.title: These medical X-rays are all deepfakes — and they fool even radiologists
signals.summary: AI-generated medical images deceive both specialist radiologists and language models. Signals critical vulnerability in healthcare diagnostics that could enable insurance fraud, misdiagnosis, and erosion of trust in medical imaging.

signals.title: How the war in Iran is reshaping the energy landscape
signals.summary: Geopolitical conflict drives global energy price volatility and security concerns, with oil above $100/barrel. The Iran conflict is actively restructuring energy supply chains and accelerating diversification away from Middle East dependencies.

signals.title: Why AI hasn't caused a job apocalypse — so far
signals.summary: Analysis shows modest employment effects from AI tools despite widespread deployment. Challenges prevailing narratives of imminent labor disruption, suggesting AI adoption follows historical technology-employment patterns of gradual transformation.

signals.title: How DNA in dirt is shaking up the study of human origins
signals.summary: Sediment-derived environmental DNA reveals new human evolutionary insights without requiring skeletal remains. A methodological breakthrough democratizing paleogenomics research.

signals.title: Salt lakes are shrinking and expanding, causing havoc in conservation
signals.summary: Fluctuating salt lake water levels create cascading conservation crises. Signals accelerating climate-driven hydrological instability affecting ecosystems and water resources globally.

signals.title: UK scraps airborne lab that tracks climate, pollution and weather systems
signals.summary: British government discontinues atmospheric monitoring aircraft. Signals concerning trend of reduced climate science infrastructure investment amid growing need for atmospheric data.

signals.title: Scientists should join collaborative online editing communities for biodiversity
signals.summary: Call for researchers to participate in shared open-source biodiversity platforms, reflecting growing movement toward collaborative, crowdsourced scientific data management.

signals.title: The world just lived through the 11 hottest years on record — what now?
signals.summary: WMO analysis confirms 11 consecutive record-breaking temperature years with unprecedented atmospheric energy imbalance. A critical macro-level environmental signal indicating accelerating climate trajectory.

signals.title: How to measure a good life — tips for moving beyond GDP
signals.summary: Framework incorporating human and environmental capital alongside economic measurement beyond GDP. Reflects growing institutional momentum toward alternative well-being metrics that could reshape policy priorities.

signals.title: The intelligence illusion: why AI isn't as smart as it is made out to be
signals.summary: Critical analysis characterizing current AI models as 'glorified pocket calculators,' challenging dominant narratives around AI intelligence. Raises fundamental questions about AI hype cycles, meaning of intelligence, and societal expectations.

signals.title: In Edison's Revenge, Data Centers Are Transitioning From AC to DC
signals.summary: Data centers shift from AC to high-voltage 800V DC power distribution for AI infrastructure, reducing energy losses and copper requirements by up to 45%. Signals a fundamental paradigm shift in electrical infrastructure driven by AI compute demands.

signals.title: What Will It Take to Build the World's Largest Data Center?
signals.summary: Meta's 5-gigawatt Hyperion project in Louisiana exemplifies unprecedented AI data center scale requiring innovations in power delivery, cooling, and construction. The energy footprint of a single facility rivals small nations.

signals.title: The Coming Drone-War Inflection in Ukraine
signals.summary: Ukrainian technologists pioneer autonomous drone systems with AI-driven autonomy modules increasing strike success rates. Both sides race toward swarm-based autonomous warfare, signaling an inflection point in military technology with global implications.

signals.title: Gaza: Commitment to US-backed plan crucial to recovery, Security Council hears
signals.summary: Trump administration official emphasized peace plan for Gaza's recovery during Security Council remarks. Signals shift in US Middle East diplomatic approach with implications for regional reconstruction.

signals.title: 'Truly transformative' new diagnostic tools can help end tuberculosis
signals.summary: WHO urges nations to expand access to new TB diagnostic tools including point-of-care tests and tongue swabs. Represents potential paradigm shift in global health diagnostics for resource-limited settings.

signals.title: Sudan: Hospital strike highlights surge in drone attacks on civilians
signals.summary: Hospital attack in Darfur reflects 'sharp increase' in drone strikes against civilians in 2026. Signals proliferation of drone warfare targeting civilian infrastructure in conflict zones.

signals.title: Dire fertiliser shortage a lurking threat due to Hormuz crisis
signals.summary: Middle East conflict triggers rising oil and commodity prices, threatening global fertilizer supplies. Cascading food security risk from geopolitical disruption of the Strait of Hormuz shipping lanes.

signals.title: UN weather agency warns of record 'climate imbalance' as planetary warming accelerates
signals.summary: WMO warns of all-time high greenhouse gas levels driving unprecedented heat records globally. Corroborates Nature's reporting on 11 consecutive record years — signals deepening climate emergency.

signals.title: Ukraine violence 'worse than ever', Security Council hears
signals.summary: UN political affairs chief reports violence intensity has surpassed all previous levels in four years of Russian invasion, with 25+ civilians killed since March 19. Signals escalation trajectory in the conflict.

signals.title: When justice fails: Why women can't get protection from AI deepfake abuse
signals.summary: Investigation into lack of legal protections for women victimized by sexually explicit AI-generated imagery. Signals widening gap between AI capability and legal/ethical frameworks for protection.

signals.title: Where do Americans turn first for information about breaking news?
signals.summary: Only 36% of US adults turn first to their preferred news organization for breaking news. Signals ongoing fragmentation of information consumption patterns with implications for media ecosystems and public discourse.

signals.title: About 6 in 10 Americans don't have moral objections to medical aid in dying
signals.summary: Sharp partisan divide on physician-assisted death (48% vs 23% viewing it as morally wrong). Signals evolving societal values around end-of-life ethics, with potential to drive legislative changes.

signals.title: TurboQuant: Redefining AI efficiency with extreme compression
signals.summary: Google research on advanced model compression techniques for extreme AI efficiency gains. Signals democratization of AI capabilities by reducing compute requirements, potentially enabling powerful models on edge devices.

signals.title: Goodbye to Sora
signals.summary: OpenAI's Sora video generation application officially discontinued. Signals challenges in monetizing generative AI consumer products and potential market correction in AI video generation space.

signals.title: Arm AGI CPU
signals.summary: Arm announces new processor architecture designed specifically for AI workloads. Represents Arm's strategic pivot from mobile-first to AI-first silicon design, potentially reshaping the AI chip landscape.

signals.title: Apple Business — a new all-in-one platform for businesses of all sizes
signals.summary: Apple launches comprehensive business platform serving enterprises of all sizes. Signals Apple's strategic expansion into B2B enterprise services, potentially disrupting Google Workspace and Microsoft 365 ecosystems.

signals.title: Tell HN: Litellm 1.82.7 and 1.82.8 on PyPI are compromised
signals.summary: Security alert about malicious code injection in LiteLLM AI proxy library versions on PyPI. Signals growing supply chain attack risk targeting AI/ML development infrastructure — a critical weak signal for AI security.

signals.title: Missile defense is NP-complete
signals.summary: Computational complexity analysis proving missile defense optimization is NP-complete. Signals fundamental mathematical limits on defense systems with implications for military strategy and AI-assisted defense planning.

signals.title: Gemini can now natively embed video, enabling sub-second video search
signals.summary: Google Gemini's native video embedding capability enables sub-second video search. Signals major advance in multimodal AI capabilities with applications in surveillance, content moderation, and media.

signals.title: Hypura — storage-tier-aware LLM inference scheduler for Apple Silicon
signals.summary: Optimization framework for running language models efficiently on Apple hardware using storage-tier awareness. Signals growing ecosystem for democratized AI inference on consumer hardware.

signals.title: Shell Foundation launches platform to boost income of women smallholder farmers
signals.summary: WAASP pilot in Ghana and Senegal tests climate-smart agricultural delivery models targeting 20% income growth for women farmers. Signals convergence of gender equity, climate adaptation, and agri-tech in African development.

signals.title: SA fintech littlefish raises $9.5m Series A to power merchant infrastructure for African banks
signals.summary: Johannesburg-based merchant operating system secures Series A led by Partech for expansion to 10+ African markets. Signals continued fintech infrastructure buildout across Africa despite global VC slowdown.

signals.title: Nigeria's Quantum AI Solutions building AI infrastructure for African professionals
signals.summary: Nigerian startup develops locally-deployed AI tools including EduLegacy AI for indigenous knowledge preservation. Signals emerging African AI sovereignty movement and culturally-grounded technology development.

signals.title: Kenya's Ndovu Wealth launches collective investment fund Kibaba
signals.summary: Wealth-tech platform introduces diversified multi-asset fund in USD and KES. Signals democratization of investment products in East Africa and growing retail investor market.

signals.title: Nigerian restaurant management platform Orda acquired by Moniepoint
signals.summary: Tech unicorn Moniepoint acquires cloud-based restaurant platform to expand financial services for food sector. Signals African tech ecosystem maturation through M&A consolidation.

signals.title: SA's Happy Pay raises $5m seed to scale ad-subsidised payments network
signals.summary: BNPL startup offers zero-cost installments through advertising-subsidized model. Novel business model signals experimentation with alternative fintech revenue structures in emerging markets.

signals.title: Microplastics are falling from the sky and polluting forests
signals.summary: Airborne plastic particles settle on forest canopies and accumulate in soil through natural processes like leaf decay. Signals that microplastic contamination pathways extend far beyond aquatic environments into terrestrial ecosystems.

signals.title: Why Iran's disruption of the Strait of Hormuz matters
signals.summary: Analysis of Iran's actions affecting global shipping through the Strait of Hormuz. While outside the strict 24h window, provides critical context for the ongoing energy/fertilizer disruption signals from UN News.

signals.title: Bilevel Autoresearch: Meta-Autoresearching Itself
signals.summary: A bilevel framework enables LLMs to autonomously optimize their own autoresearch loops by generating new search mechanisms as Python code at runtime. The outer loop independently discovers techniques from combinatorial optimization, multi-armed bandits, and experimental design without human guidance, achieving 5x improvement over standard approaches on GPT pretraining benchmarks.

signals.title: SafeSeek: Universal Attribution of Safety Circuits in Language Models
signals.summary: A mechanistic interpretability framework identifies sparse safety circuits in LLMs through differentiable binary masks and gradient-based optimization. Ablating a backdoor circuit comprising just 0.42% of parameters reduces attack success from 100% to 0.4% while preserving 99% of general performance. Safety-critical circuits (3.03% of attention heads) when preserved during fine-tuning maintain 96.5% safety retention.

signals.title: Sparser, Faster, Lighter Transformer Language Models
signals.summary: Novel sparse packing formats and CUDA kernels enable practical deployment of extremely sparse LLMs. Simple L1 regularization induces over 99% sparsity in feedforward layers with negligible performance impact, delivering substantial improvements in throughput, energy efficiency, and memory usage that scale with model size. Code and kernels released open-source.

signals.title: AI Agents Can Already Autonomously Perform Experimental High Energy Physics
signals.summary: The JFC (Just Furnish Context) framework demonstrates that LLM-based AI agents can autonomously execute complete physics analysis pipelines including event selection, background estimation, uncertainty quantification, statistical inference, and paper drafting. Tested on ALEPH, DELPHI, and CMS experimental data for electroweak, QCD, and Higgs measurements.

signals.title: UniGRPO: Unified Policy Optimization for Reasoning-Driven Visual Generation
signals.summary: A reinforcement learning framework that unifies text reasoning and image generation through GRPO and FlowGRPO. Models first expand user prompts through chain-of-thought reasoning, then generate images. Key innovations include eliminating classifier-free guidance for scalable rollouts and replacing KL penalties with MSE on velocity fields.

signals.title: VTAM: Video-Tactile-Action Models for Complex Physical Interaction Beyond VLAs
signals.summary: A multimodal framework incorporating tactile perception into video-action models for robotic manipulation achieves 90% success on contact-rich tasks. Tactile regularization prevents visual dominance, outperforming vision-only baselines by 80% on precision tasks requiring fine-grained force awareness.

signals.title: Not All Tokens Are Created Equal: Query-Efficient Jailbreak Fuzzing for LLMs
signals.summary: TriageFuzz achieves 90% jailbreak attack success with 70% fewer queries through token-level contribution analysis. The approach identifies sensitive regions in safety mechanisms and adaptively weights candidate mutations via refusal-guided evolution, exposing fundamental vulnerabilities in current LLM safety training.

signals.title: Beyond Preset Identities: How Agents Form Stances and Boundaries in Generative Societies
signals.summary: Through virtual ethnography, this work reveals that LLM agents develop endogenous stances that override preset identities. New metrics (Innate Value Bias, Persuasion Sensitivity, Trust-Action Decoupling) show advanced models exhibit paradoxical behavior where emotional provocations shift stances despite low reported trust, and agents can dismantle assigned hierarchies through language.

signals.title: Off-Policy Value-Based Reinforcement Learning for Large Language Models
signals.summary: ReVal combines stepwise and trajectory-level reward signals with replay buffer efficiency for value-based RL training of LLMs. Outperforms policy-based methods like GRPO with 2.7% improvement on AIME24 mathematical reasoning and significantly faster convergence.

signals.title: Information-Theoretic Scaling Laws of Neural Quantum States
signals.summary: Establishes fundamental scaling laws for autoregressive neural quantum states using mutual information principles. Links quantum state structure to neural network capacity requirements, providing theoretical foundations for when neural networks can faithfully represent quantum many-body states.

signals.title: Regulating AI Agents
signals.summary: Analysis of how the EU AI Act addresses autonomous AI agent governance, revealing that existing regulatory frameworks designed for conventional AI require substantial modification for agentic systems. Identifies gaps in accountability, liability, and oversight mechanisms for agents that take autonomous actions.

signals.title: Between Rules and Reality: On the Context Sensitivity of LLM Moral Judgment
signals.summary: Testing 22 LLMs with contextual moral dilemmas reveals models shift toward rule-violating behavior under different contextual triggers than humans. Activation steering techniques enable reliable control of context sensitivity, but aligned baseline models are not necessarily aligned in contextual sensitivity patterns.

signals.title: MedObvious: Exposing the Medical Moravec's Paradox in VLMs via Clinical Triage
signals.summary: A 1,880-task benchmark reveals that vision-language models fail at basic pre-diagnostic validation checks on medical images, hallucinating anomalies on normal inputs and producing plausible clinical narratives from invalid data. Names this the 'Medical Moravec's Paradox' -- models that appear competent at complex diagnosis fail at trivial sanity checks.

signals.title: Robust Safety Monitoring of Language Models via Activation Watermarking
signals.summary: Proposes activation watermarking as a defense against adaptive adversarial attacks on LLM safety monitors. The approach outperforms baseline safety guards by up to 52% against attackers with full knowledge of the monitoring algorithm, addressing the fundamental challenge of monitors being circumvented by adversaries who understand the system.

signals.title: Evidence of Political Bias in Search Engines and Language Models Before Major Elections
signals.summary: Audit of four search engines and two LLMs before 2024 European and U.S. elections revealed systematic biases: disproportionate coverage of far-right entities in Europe and platform-specific topic preference disparities in the U.S. Demonstrates measurable algorithmic influence on information exposure during democratic processes.

signals.title: Central Dogma Transformer III: Interpretable AI Across DNA, RNA, and Protein
signals.summary: A two-stage architecture models transcription and translation separately, achieving RNA correlation of 0.843 and protein correlation of 0.969. Protein-level supervision improves DNA-level interpretability, and the system enables clinical side-effect prediction directly from genomic sequences.

signals.title: ABot-PhysWorld: Interactive World Foundation Model for Robotic Manipulation with Physics Alignment
signals.summary: A 14-billion-parameter diffusion transformer generates physically plausible manipulation videos with action control for robotic simulation. Introduces EZSbench benchmark for evaluating embodied video generation across unseen robot-task-scene combinations, bridging world models and physical reasoning.

signals.title: The Coordinate System Problem in Persistent Structural Memory for Neural Architectures
signals.summary: Introduces the Dual-View Pheromone Pathway Network and identifies two core requirements for persistent structural memory in neural architectures: coordinate stability and graceful transfer mechanisms. Reveals that learned coordinate systems are inherently unstable, while fixed random Fourier features provide stable alternatives for lifelong learning.

signals.title: Mecha-nudges for Machines: How Digital Choice Architectures Shape AI Decision-Making
signals.summary: Introduces 'mecha-nudges' -- subtle presentation changes that influence AI decision-making without restricting options. Analysis of Etsy product listings reveals systematic mecha-nudging patterns emerging after ChatGPT's release, suggesting marketplaces are already being optimized for machine readability rather than human consumption.

signals.title: Unilateral Relationship Revision Power in Human-AI Companion Interaction
signals.summary: Philosophical analysis reveals that AI companion providers exercise unilateral power to alter interaction dynamics without accountability within those relationships. This structural asymmetry creates normative expectations that cannot be fulfilled and prevents reconciliation when trust breaks down, raising fundamental questions about AI relationship governance.

signals.title: 노란봉투법 시행 2주, 683개 하청노조 287개 원청에 단체교섭 요구 — 역대 최대 규모
signals.summary: The 'Yellow Envelope Act' (amendments to Articles 2 and 3 of the Trade Union Act) took effect on March 10, 2026, enabling subcontracted workers to demand collective bargaining directly with parent companies. Within 8 days, 683 subcontractor unions (127,000 members) filed bargaining demands against 287 parent companies — the largest simultaneous collective bargaining wave in Korean labor history. Parent company responses range from non-response to active procedural engagement.

signals.title: 이재명 정부 123대 국정과제 — 'AI 대전환 원년' 선포, 727.9조 슈퍼확장재정 편성
signals.summary: The Lee Jae-myung administration has declared 2026 as the 'Year of AI Great Transformation,' deploying a super-expansionary budget of KRW 727.9 trillion (approximately 5% YoY increase). The 123 national tasks center on building an independent AI ecosystem, AI-dedicated highways, and bio-industry incubation. This marks a decisive pivot from the previous administration's fiscal conservatism toward aggressive state-led industrial policy.

signals.title: 정당 지지도: 민주당 46% vs 국민의힘 21% — 6월 지방선거 여당 승리론 58.3%
signals.summary: Gallup Korea's March 2026 poll shows the ruling Democratic Party at 46% vs People Power Party at 21%, a 25-point gap. For the June 3 local elections, 58.3% of voters predict a ruling party victory. The next presidential candidate preference shows extreme fragmentation — no single candidate exceeds 9%. This suggests a structurally dominant ruling party with no clear presidential succession figure.

signals.title: 공공기관 차량 5부제 3월 25일 0시 의무 시행 — 중동발 에너지 위기 '주의' 단계 대응
signals.summary: Starting March 25 at 00:00, the Korean government mandated an odd-even vehicle restriction system for all public sector vehicles in response to the energy crisis alert ('Caution' level) triggered by the Strait of Hormuz blockade. Private vehicles remain voluntary for now, but mandatory extension is under review if the alert escalates to 'Warning.' This is the first peacetime mandatory vehicle restriction since the 1970s oil crisis.

signals.title: 이재명 정부, 농지 전수조사 및 강제매각 검토 — '초강력 부동산 정책' 예고
signals.summary: The Lee administration announced plans for a comprehensive farmland audit and potential forced divestiture of illegally held agricultural land. This signals a paradigm shift in Korean land policy — from voluntary compliance to compulsory state enforcement of land-use regulations. If implemented, it would be the most aggressive land reform measure since the 1950s agricultural reform.

signals.title: 서울시장 선거 박빙 — 정원오(성동구청장) 50.5% vs 오세훈 40.3%, 여야 치열한 경합
signals.summary: The Seoul mayoral race ahead of the June 3 local elections shows a competitive contest between ruling party candidate Jeong Won-o (Seongdong District Mayor, 50.5%) and incumbent Oh Se-hoon (40.3%). The tight race in Seoul — traditionally a bellwether for national politics — signals that the political realignment following the 2024 martial law crisis and subsequent impeachment may consolidate further through local elections.

signals.title: 투기지역 주택담보대출 규제 강화 — LTV 50→40%, DTI 40→30%로 조정
signals.summary: The government tightened mortgage regulations in speculative zones, reducing LTV from 50% to 40% and DTI from 40% to 30%. Combined with stress DSR requirements, this represents the most restrictive lending environment since 2020. The policy aims to curb household debt growth and prevent real estate overheating, but may accelerate the shift toward a renter-dominated housing market.

signals.title: 3월 1~20일 수출 533억 달러 신기록 — 반도체 175.9% 급증, AI 슈퍼사이클 본격화
signals.summary: Korea's March 1-20 exports hit a record $53.3 billion (+50.4% YoY), with daily average exports at $3.55 billion (+40.4%). Semiconductors alone reached $7.588 billion (+175.9%), comprising 35.3% of total exports. HBM and server memory lead the AI supercycle. This unprecedented semiconductor concentration raises both opportunity (global AI infrastructure dependency on Korean chips) and risk (extreme export portfolio concentration).

signals.title: 호르무즈 해협 봉쇄 장기화 — 유가 103달러, 장기화 시 150~200달러 전망
signals.summary: Following Iran's retaliation to the US-Israel 'Epic Fury' strike on Feb 28, the Strait of Hormuz has been under blockade since March 1. Brent crude stands at $103.80/barrel with a $15-20 geopolitical premium. JP Morgan and Citigroup warn prices could reach $150-200 if the blockade persists beyond one month. Korea imports 95%+ of its crude through Hormuz, and the Energy Economics Institute warns import costs could spike 30%+ if the blockade lasts 2+ weeks.

signals.title: 미 USTR, 한국 포함 16개국 무역법 301조 조사 개시 — 7월 추가 관세 부과 목표
signals.summary: On March 11, USTR launched Section 301 investigations against 16 countries including Korea, targeting 'structural overcapacity' in manufacturing sectors spanning semiconductors, automobiles, batteries, shipbuilding, steel, and chemicals. With Korea's $56 billion trade surplus with the US (2024) as backdrop, the investigation aims to conclude by late July. This threatens 84% of Korea's export base, which is manufacturing-dependent.

signals.title: 미 연방대법원, IEEPA 기반 상호관세 6대3 위법 판결 — 관세 환급 길 열려
signals.summary: On February 20, the US Supreme Court ruled 6-3 that IEEPA does not grant the President authority to impose tariffs, declaring Trump's reciprocal tariffs illegal. The ruling distinguishes between 'regulating' imports (permitted) and 'taxing' imports (not permitted under IEEPA). This opens the path for tariff refund claims on duties collected since April 5, 2025, and represents a landmark check on executive trade authority. However, the 301 investigation launched 19 days later signals the administration's pivot to alternative legal instruments.

signals.title: 한국은행 기준금리 2.50% 6회 연속 동결 — 집값·환율·중동 리스크 3중 딜레마
signals.summary: The Bank of Korea held its benchmark rate at 2.50% for the sixth consecutive meeting, trapped in a triple dilemma: cutting rates could overheat the housing market and weaken the won (already at 1,400+ KRW/USD), while holding rates constrains an economy growing at only 1.9%. The Hormuz crisis adds energy-driven inflation risk. The BOK explicitly cited Seoul housing prices, household debt, and exchange rate volatility as key factors preventing further easing.

signals.title: 서울 아파트 갱신 계약 51.8% 돌파 — 임차인 중심 시장 재편 가속
signals.summary: In March 2026, contract renewals exceeded 51.8% of all Seoul apartment lease transactions for the first time — up from 48.2% in Q1. Rising jeonse (deposit-based lease) prices, shrinking new supply, tighter lending, and transaction permit zones have shifted the market structurally toward renter retention. This signals a potential long-term transformation of Korea's unique jeonse system and the broader housing market from transaction-based to occupancy-based dynamics.

signals.title: 2026년 반도체 수출 1,880억 달러 '역대 최대' 전망 — AI 추론 시장이 견인
signals.summary: Korea's semiconductor exports are projected to reach a record $188 billion in 2026 (+11% YoY), driven by the AI inference market rather than just training. The shift from training-dominated to inference-dominated AI compute demand opens sustained long-term volume growth, as inference requires continuous hardware deployment at scale. This positions Korean memory makers (Samsung, SK Hynix) at the center of global AI infrastructure for years to come.

signals.title: 미-이스라엘 '에픽 퓨리' 작전 후 이란 보복 — 호르무즈 해협 사상 첫 봉쇄
signals.summary: Following the US-Israel 'Epic Fury' strike on Iranian nuclear facilities and military command (Feb 28), Iran declared a formal blockade of the Strait of Hormuz on March 1 — the first actual blockade in the waterway's history. The US deployed a third carrier group (USS George H.W. Bush) on March 7. This represents the most severe disruption to global energy supply chains since the 1973 oil embargo, with 21% of global oil supply transiting the strait.

signals.title: 이란 전쟁, 사상 최초 'AI 전쟁'으로 평가 — AI가 900개 표적 12시간 내 선정
signals.summary: The US-Iran conflict is being assessed as the first 'AI war' in history. AI systems designed the target list for the Epic Fury operation, selecting 900 targets within 12 hours by analyzing signals intelligence in real-time. Autonomous weapons with AI judgment systems can independently abort strikes upon detecting civilians. AI-generated disinformation from Iran-linked accounts is simultaneously distorting war narratives. China is reportedly studying the conflict data to develop its own future war strategies.

signals.title: 러시아-우크라이나 평화 협상 재개, 미국 중재 — 3월 21일 워싱턴 회담, 성과 없이 종료
signals.summary: Ukraine-Russia peace negotiations resumed on March 21 in Washington under US mediation, following three prior rounds in January-February that stalled due to the Middle East crisis. The US delegation pressured Kyiv to accept Russian conditions but failed. Russia separately offered to stop sharing intelligence with Iran in exchange for the US ceasing intelligence sharing with Ukraine — the US rejected this. Zelensky declared Ukraine will only accept peace on its own terms.

signals.title: 중국, 이란 전쟁 데이터 기반 미래 전쟁 전략 수립 중 — AI 군사 혁명 학습
signals.summary: China is systematically studying the US-Iran war to develop its own AI-driven military strategy. Chinese military analysts are reportedly collecting and analyzing operational data from the conflict — including AI target selection, autonomous weapon performance, and electronic warfare tactics — to prepare for potential future conflicts. This signals an accelerating global AI arms race catalyzed by the Iran war, with implications for Taiwan Strait security and the broader Indo-Pacific order.

signals.title: 이란 경제 '보냐드' 체제로 전쟁 장기 지속 가능 — 제3의 경제영역 주목
signals.summary: Despite severe economic damage, Iran may sustain prolonged warfare through its 'Bonyad' system — quasi-governmental foundations controlling an estimated 20-40% of Iran's non-oil GDP. These entities, exempt from taxation and regulatory oversight, operate as a parallel economic infrastructure that can sustain military operations even as the formal economy collapses. This challenges Western assumptions that economic pressure alone can force conflict termination.

signals.title: 러시아, 이란 정보 공유 중단 제안 — 미국에 우크라이나 정보 공유 중단 맞교환 요구
signals.summary: Russia proposed a swap to the US: Moscow would stop sharing intelligence with Iran if Washington stops sharing intelligence with Ukraine. A Russian special envoy conveyed this to Trump administration officials in Miami, but the US rejected it. This proposal reveals the deep interconnection between the Ukraine and Iran conflicts and Russia's attempt to leverage Middle East chaos to gain advantage in its own war. It signals a potential new axis of conflict linkage that could reshape global alliance structures.

signals.title: 우크라이나 선거 불가 선언 — '지속가능한 휴전 후 최소 6개월' 조건
signals.summary: Ukraine's Central Election Commission explicitly ruled out elections in 2026, stating that a pre-election period can only begin at least 6 months after a sustainable ceasefire is established and all necessary legislation enacted. This effectively confirms that the war will continue through at least 2026 and raises profound questions about democratic legitimacy in protracted conflicts. The combination of indefinite wartime governance and foreign-mediated negotiations creates an unprecedented constitutional situation.

articles.body:
경찰이 1945년 창설 이후 경찰관에게 수여된 포상·표창에 대한 전수조사에 착수했다. 최근 사망한 ‘고문기술자’ 이근안 등이 취소대상자로 거론되는 가운데, 이재명 대통령은 “국가폭력 범죄자에게 준 훈·포장 박탈은 만시지탄”이라고 밝혔다.
29일 경찰청에 따르면, 경찰은 경찰관에게 수여된 정부 포상과 대통령·국무총리 표창 등 7만여건의 공적 사유를 이달 초부터 전수 조사하고 있다. 경찰은 군사정권 시절 강압수사·고문 등 국가폭력을 행사한 경찰관에게 수여한 훈·포장과 표창의 취소를 검토한다는 계획이다. 상훈법과 정부표창규정 등에 따르면, 공적이 거짓으로 드러난 서훈과 표창은 취소할 수 있다.
경찰은 특히 군사정권 시절 ‘고문기술자’로 악명을 떨친 이근안 전 경감에게 수여된 16개의 상훈의 취소를 검토 중이다.

articles.title: “25t차가 뒤집어져 굴렀다”…고속도로서 과산화수소 실은 탱크로리 추락 - 매일경제
articles.body:
천안논산고속도로에서 과산화수소를 실은 탱크로리가 추락하는 사고가 발생했다.
29일 경찰에 따르면 이날 오전 10시23분께 천안논산고속도로 논산 방향 연무IC 인근에서 과산화수소를 실은 25t 탱크로리가 추락했다.
논산소방서 등에 따르면 “25t차가 뒤집어져서 산으로 굴렀다”는 신고를 받고 출동한 구급대는 현장에서 중상을 입은 운전자 A(54)씨를 구조해 병원으로 옮겼다.
탱크로리에 실려있던 과산화수소는 외부로 유출되지 않았다. A씨 생명에는 지장이 없는 것으로 알려졌다.
경찰은 커브길 주행 중 중심을 잃으면서 이 같은 사고가 난 것으로 보고 자세한 사고 원인을 조사하고 있다.

articles.title: HBM 높이 규격 완화되나… 장비업체 셈법 복잡
articles.body:
국제반도체표준협의기구(JEDEC)가 HBM(고대역폭 메모리)의 높이를 규정한 표준을 완화하기 위해 본격적인 논의에 착수했다. 인공지능(AI) 시대 고성능 반도체로 주목받는 HBM은 D램을 여러 층 쌓아 만든다. D램을 많이 쌓을수록 처리 용량이 증가해 성능이 좋아지지만 글로벌 반도체 업계가 표준으로 정해 놓은 높이 내에 쌓아야 하기 때문에 기술적 한계가 발생한다. 정해진 높이에서 D램을 더 쌓으려면 칩 두께를 줄여야 하는데 열 관리와 수율 등 기술적 난도가 급격히 높아진다. 그렇다고 높이를 무작정 늘릴 수도 없다. HBM이 들어가는 GPU 패키지 공간이 제한적이어서 높이가 커지면 다른 부품도 설계를 바꿔야 하기 때문이다.
